title: Winding up of Paytm Payments Bank Limited
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has, vide order dated April 24, 2026, cancelled the banking licence issued to Paytm Payments Bank Limited (PPBL) under Section 22(4) of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 (‘BR Act’) effective from close of business on April 24, 2026. As indicated in the Press Release issued on the said date, the Reserve Bank, in exercise of powers conferred under Sections 38 and 39 of the Banking Regulation Act 1949, made an application before the Hon’ble High Cour
